data.title: 诀 · 山崖无边温水池畔休憩
data.action: 扶着山崖无边池畔石沿凝望远山后回眸
data.location: 高地度假崖边无边水池
data.lighting: 柔和橘粉晚霞与清蓝池水反光
data.description: 高地崖边的无边温水池倒映着淡橘色晚霞。换上朱砂红露背连体泳装的李织烟外披半透明玄黑轻纱站在池畔，微湿的发丝与雪青羽翼在晚风中轻轻晃动。她偏头回望，冷白肌肤与朱红泳装在霞光下形成鲜明而克制的视觉张力。
data.promptProse: Standing beside a cliffside infinity pool reflecting warm sunset clouds, Arcane wears a vermilion halter one-piece swimsuit draped with a sheer black beach cover-up and glances back over her shoulder with cool poise.
data.animaCaption: She pauses beside the sunset-lit cliffside infinity pool, glancing back over her shoulder as the breeze lifts her sheer black cover-up.
